name: Gaia2
intro: Gaia2是一个用于在真实、异步环境中评估大型语言模型代理的基准。它引入了独立于代理行为而演变的环境场景，要求代理在时间限制下操作、适应动态和嘈杂的事件、解决模糊性并与其他代理协作。每个场景都配有写操作验证器，支持细粒度的动作级评估。该基准建立在开源的ARE平台之上，旨在推动下一代实用代理系统的发展。
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
task_type: Agent评估, 复杂推理, 动态适应, 多步推理
eval_feature: 异步, 动态环境, 多Agent协作, 时间限制, 噪声鲁棒性, 模糊性解决
scale: 1,120个场景（800个核心场景 + 320个增强场景）
task_type_en: Agent Evaluation, Complex Reasoning, Dynamic Adaptation, Multi-step Reasoning
eval_feature_en: Asynchronous, dynamic environment, multi-agent collaboration, time constraints, noise robustness, ambiguity resolution
intro_en: Gaia2 is a benchmark for evaluating large language model agents in real, asynchronous environments. It introduces environment scenarios that evolve independently of agent behavior, requiring agents to operate within time constraints, adapt to dynamic and noisy events, resolve ambiguities, and collaborate with other agents. Each scenario includes a write operation validator, enabling fine-grained, action-level evaluation. Built on the open-source ARE platform, this benchmark aims to advance the development of next-generation practical agent systems.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2602.11964. Gaia2 is built on ARE's asynchronous apps, event DAGs, time, notifications, scenarios, and write verification. Mobile provides 12 apps and 101 tools across 10 PersonaHub-seeded, dependency-consistent user universes containing 400K–800K tokens; simulated time advances during model generation. Humans author oracle DAGs of initial state, write actions, and environment events to isolate Execution, Search, Ambiguity, Adaptability, or Time. Multiple independent validation rounds, consistency checks, graph guardrails, and baseline-agent calibration yield 800 unique core scenarios and a 160-item mini subset. Applying Noise and Agent2Agent environment modifiers to mini adds 320 scenarios, for 1,120 total. All models use a ReAct-style one-JSON-call scaffold at temperature 0.5, 16K tokens per turn, three runs, and at most 200 steps. The ARE Verifier checks exact/flexible arguments, causality, timing, and completeness for every write action; on 450 trajectories it reaches 0.98 agreement and 0.99 precision. The primary metric is Pass@1 by split and overall.
